why: Same carrier/structure mismatch as V10_19. A (remark_10_2_3) is about the project's epGroupoid F G _ on Obj F G, with the iterated sub-M-polyfold structure. B is about some E on objSetB ⊆ X × 𝐘 × Z, with the triple-product structure (IsWFPEpB). B ⇒ A is proved with the comparison functor toE (copied from the V10_19 item; an sc-smooth functor with an sc-smooth inverse, hence an equivalence). π_X = πX∘toE and π_Z = πZ∘toE are equivalences by B. A's τ with τ(x, ϕ, z) = ϕ is the project's natTrans (a V10_19 definition); B only asserts some natural transformation, so B's τ is not used. The witness remark_10_2_3_negFunctor is the same core applied to id and negFunctor (equivalences by non-item lemmas), with the object (0, 1_0, 0) given by hand. A ⇒ B fails, and is believed true. It needs an E with IsWFPEpB (triple-product sub-M-polyfold structures and the transported ep-groupoid structure), which the project does not prove (the V10_18 gap).
